testing_progress.highlight: Ethrex testnet live 14 days; Ethrex, Geth, Nethermind validating; ~400 frame txs from 21 senders
Besu not yet on Ethrex testnet; entry requirement is passing latest execution-specs EIP-8141 test release (v0.3.0)
frames-devnet-0 blocked on EthPandaOps availability; Geth, ethrex, Nethermind ready to participate

eip_proposals_multidimensional_fee.highlight: EIP-7999 unified max fee: replace per-resource max fees with single fungible max fee; reduces stale-tx exclusion risk
State limit in bytes (not gas) proposed: safe across repricing, simpler for wallets, converted to gas at processing time
EVM gas accounting options: aggregate gas, sub-fee accounting, or full multidimensional with universal overflow channel — 6 total combinations under consideration
L2 interest (Base): unified max fee useful today — L1 data fee is multidimensional but users currently cannot set a limit

community_feedback.highlight: viem (jxom): JSON-RPC for frame txs underspecified; needs eth_estimateGas support, eth_fillTransaction, and simulation (eth_simulateV1 extension or new eth_simulateFrameTransaction)
lightclient (chat): prefers simulateV2 extending simulateV1 with frame modes and multidim gas; opposes Ivan's raw RLP approach in eth_simulateFrameTransaction PR
Ethlabs (Mislav): ERC effort to harmonize EIP-8130 + EIP-8141; targets 7906, 7715, 7710, 5792 wallet-call API, clear signing, privacy, cross-chain batching

organizational.highlight: Daniil requests frames-devnet-0 max verified gas raised from 100K to 500K to enable complex scenario testing; lightclient approves

action_items.action: Open R&D thread on ERC-8403 + EIP-8130 keystore compatibility PR
Follow up with EthPandaOps on frames-devnet-0 launch timing; confirm 500K max verified gas config
Involve EIP-8037 gas accounting devs in frames multidimensional gas accounting discussion

decisions.decision: frames-devnet-0 max verified gas set to 500K (up from 100K default) to support complex test scenarios

targets.target: frames-devnet-0 launch — pending EthPandaOps availability (post Sep 22, 2026)
